exposure: mechanical ventilation within the first 72 h
chorioamnionitis involving the maternal side of the placenta
inotropic support within 72 h after birth
cohort: Very low-birth weight infants born at the Gaslini Children's Hospital between January 2012 and October 2016 (n=286)
finding: Chorioamnionitis involving the maternal side of the placenta was an independent risk factor for developing intraventricular hemorrhage, while inotropic support and intraventricular hemorrhage were independent risk factors for cerebellar hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean section emerged as a protective factor against intraventricular hemorrhage.
